data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were GBP 5.1479m (gross). By 31 December 2016 gross claims outstanding increased to GBP 11.7881m reflecting an increase in claims provisions during 2016. The report highlights an adverse underwriting event affecting the 2016 underwriting year which has been reserved for prudently; however no explicit gross prior-year (pre-2016) reserve movement figure is published for prior years. The syndicate reports a declared return on the 2014 year of account and the 2015 year of account is forecast to break even, indicating mixed prior-year outcomes but no single gross prior-year movement amount is given.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate's current year loss is driven by an adverse underwriting event impacting the 2016 underwriting year.
This event has been reserved for on a prudent basis, however, there remains greater uncertainty than usual as to the ultimate result.
The 2014 year of account declares a return on capacity of 15.3%.
The 2015 year of account currently forecasts closing at a break even position.
The claims ratio has increased to 78% (2015: 57%).
In 2016, the amount spent on outward reinsurance was GBP 557.9k (2015: GBP 688.9k).
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (Insurance liabilities column) was found. The gross claims development triangle is present but the published table on page 29/30 is formatted as development percentages and small per-year 3622 share amounts; prior-diagonal cumulative values required to compute a gross prior-year development were not provided in an unambiguous tabular form. As a result prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null. Gross premium mix was taken from the managing agent 'Operating divisions' (Life insurance / Life reinsurance) because no regulatory segmental analysis with statutory class names was available; 'mix from divisional summary'. The claims development triangle is present but not reliably parsed for numerical prior-diagonal comparison due to formatting/aggregation (see claims triangle note).

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development triangle (percentages and per-year gross liabilities) is printed on page 29, but the printed layout/format did not provide the prior-diagonal cumulative values in a straightforward numeric table for extraction. The triangle was therefore not converted into full numeric development rows here.
